title: Axygen Checklist file, format version 1
description: A checklist for the Axygen Checklist add-on for NVDA. Sections hold items; the add-on records the outcome of each item back into this same file. Normative source: docs/requirements.md, section 2. Authoring guide: docs/checklist-format.md.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. The add-on never reads or writes it; it survives as an unknown field.

format_version.description: Version of the file format. Optional; absent means 1. A version above the one the add-on knows makes it refuse the file.

checklist_name.description: Name of the checklist. Content, not interface: never translated.

sections.description: Sections of the checklist. At least one; flat lists without sections are not supported.

additionalProperties.description: Unknown properties are allowed. The add-on ignores them on read and preserves them when it rewrites the file.

section_name.description: Name of the section. Content, not interface: never translated.

items.description: Items in this section. May be empty.

additionalProperties.description: Unknown properties are allowed. The add-on ignores them on read and preserves them when it rewrites the file.

item.title: Item
item.description: One thing to check. Uniqueness of `id` across the whole file is required but cannot be expressed in JSON Schema; see docs/requirements.md, section 2.

id.description: Identifier of the item, unique within the file. Written by the author, never renumbered: it is what keeps an item the same item across edits.

text.description: The text of the item, spoken by the screen reader. Content, not interface: never translated.

status.description: Outcome of the check, written by the tester through the add-on. Optional; absent means "pending". An identifier, not text: never translated. An unrecognised value makes the add-on refuse the whole file.

note.description: Hint written by the author before the run, spoken automatically after the item text. Read-only in the add-on. Content, not interface: never translated.

comment.description: Conclusion written by the tester after the check. Erased when a section or the whole checklist is reset. Content, not interface: never translated.

additionalProperties.description: Unknown properties are allowed. The add-on ignores them on read and preserves them when it rewrites the file.
